responsibility: Declares GCC’s JSON parsing interface that converts UTF-8 buffers into json::value trees. It defines the location-tracking abstraction used by the parser to report source positions for parsed values, the json::error object that carries a message plus source range, the generic result wrapper used to return either a value or an error, the parser_result_t typedef, and the parse_utf8_string overloads that let clients choose comment support and optionally receive parse-location mappings.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public JSON parsing API and support types used by other GCC code: location_map, error, the generic result wrapper, parser_result_t, and parse_utf8_string overloads. Unlike json-parsing.cc, it does not implement lexing or recursive-descent parsing; it provides the interface, ownership contracts, and callback abstractions the implementation uses.
